text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The challenge of the Classics begins this year. I decide to watch some TV to see what our competition looks like.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: We have quite an interesting line up for the Classics this year.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: We have the peerless Sakura Bakushin O in the sprints. Rice Shower has also announced her intentions to compete, but…

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: There's no way she can beat Mihono Bourbon, who can potentially become the Triple Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Mihono Bourbon is leagues ahead of the other racers who debuted last year.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Hi, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Hi, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah. It's me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. I wanted to come and wish you a happy New Year… Am I interrupting something?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah… that's good.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Anyway, I talked to Urara this morning.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: She said she was going to make a New Year's resolution… and then she asked if resolutions are yummy.
choice_data_list: I… don't think they're very tasty.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haha, me neither. That's what I told her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, anyway…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I was hoping that we could make our resolution for this year together…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I was hoping that we could make our resolutions for this year together…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Unless… you don't want to…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yay! Now, what should my goal be?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …What about you? What's your goal for this year?
choice_data_list: To make you a racer worthy of competing against Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …What about you? What's your goal for this year?
choice_data_list: To make you a racer worthy of competing against Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Actually…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is it okay if I make my goal the same as yours?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Then it's decided.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best to achieve our goal.
choice_data_list: That's what I like to hear!
Be sure to keep your health in mind too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best to achieve our goal.
choice_data_list: That's what I like to hear!
Be sure to keep your health in mind too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right! I might not do well at first, but…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I won't ever give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Rice Shower makes a new vow.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh… It would be just my luck to catch a cold before a race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And I don't want to miss out on training with you…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And I don't want to miss out on training with you…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh, I'll just have to be perfectly healthy forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing the panic in her voice start to rise, I quickly work to calm her down while we make a training plan together.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Ehehe. You're kind of like a teacher.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Ehehe. You're kind of like a teacher.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Heehee… I'm looking forward to your next lesson… Teacher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Rice Shower and I watch some race footage together to study up on Mihono Bourbon.
